verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows ops users configuring verification logic without code. There is no documented flow builder, conditional steps, risk-based routing, country-specific requirement rules, or template changes that avoid an engineering deploy. The 'No-code identity verification solution' item is a bare title that never mentions configuring logic. Zapier automation acts on decisions after verification, and SDK branding customization changes appearance only, so both are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can configure verification logic without code — conditional steps, risk-based routing, country-specific requirements, and template changes that don't need an engineering deploy
